name: dare-mcp

tools.name: dare_list_models
tools.description: List the video and image models available on Dare with their supported durations, aspect ratios, quality tiers and reference limits. Call this before generating so parameters are valid for the chosen model, and dare_estimate_cost for prices. Makes no network request and spends no credits.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

tools.name: dare_estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of a generation before running it, using Dare's own pricing table. Purely local arithmetic: no network request, no credits spent. Use this to check affordability, compare quality tiers, or size a batch.

quality.description: Quality tier, e.g. `720p` for video or `2k` for image.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio; affects cost on `gpt-image-2` only.

audio_enabled.description: Whether audio is generated (affects Veo and Kling).

reference_video_seconds.description: Total seconds of video references attached; billed in addition on Seedance 2.5.

reference_count.description: Number of reference assets attached (images count toward image-model surcharges).

video_reference_count.description: How many of the references are video clips. Only video references earn Seedance's 0.6x discount.

tools.name: dare_get_credit_balance
tools.description: Fetch the signed-in Dare account's current credit balance. Read-only. Use before a large batch to confirm there is enough headroom.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

tools.name: dare_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a text prompt on Dare, defaulting to Seedance 2.5. SPENDS CREDITS from the signed-in Dare account (a 10s 720p Seedance 2.5 clip is ~110 credits; call dare_estimate_cost first). Returns generation ids immediately. Rendering is slow — Seedance 2.5 jobs commonly take 5–15 minutes — so leave wait_seconds at 0 and poll with dare_get_generation, or set it only if your client tolerates long tool calls. Attach reference images, clips or audio by uploading them first with dare_upload_media and passing the storage keys.

prompt.description: What the video should show. Be specific about subject, action, camera and style.

model.description: Video model id. Seedance 2.5 supports up to 30 seconds.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length in seconds. Seedance 2.5: 4–30; Seedance 2.0: 4–15; Kling: 3–15; Veo: 4/6/8 (8 with a reference); Hailuo: fixed. Ignored when a Seedance 2.5 video reference sets it.

quality.description: Quality tier, e.g. `480p` or `720p` for Seedance 2.5.

audio_enabled.description: Generate synchronised audio where the model supports it.

reference_storage_keys.description: Storage keys from dare_upload_media to use as reference images, clips or audio.

count.description: Number of variations. Each one costs credits.

project_id.description: Optional Dare project to file the generation under.

wait_seconds.description: Block up to this many seconds waiting for the result. 0 returns immediately.

dry_run.description: Validate the request, resolve references and price it, but do not submit. Spends nothing. Returns the exact spec that would be sent.

tools.name: dare_generate_image
tools.description: Generate a still image on Dare with Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2 or Seedream 5 Pro. SPENDS CREDITS. Useful for producing a reference frame to feed into dare_generate_video.

reference_storage_keys.description: Storage keys to use as references.

wait_seconds.description: Block up to this long for the result.

dry_run.description: Validate and price without submitting. Spends nothing.

tools.name: dare_get_generation
tools.description: Fetch one generation by id: its status (queued, processing, succeeded, failed), credits charged, and — once finished — the output asset URL. Read-only. Poll this after dare_generate_video; video jobs commonly take 5–15 minutes. Use wait_seconds to block for up to that long per call, sized to what your client's tool timeout allows (e.g. 45 for desktop apps, 300+ for Claude Code), and call again until status is terminal.

generation_id.description: Generation id returned by a dare_generate_* tool.

wait_seconds.description: Poll until the generation leaves a pending state, up to this many seconds.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

tools.name: dare_list_generations
tools.description: List recent items in the Dare library — generations and uploads, newest first — with cursor pagination. Read-only. Use it to find an earlier video's id or an upload's storage key.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

tools.name: dare_cancel_generation
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight generation. Use when a job was started by mistake, to stop it consuming credits.

tools.name: dare_delete_generation
tools.description: Permanently delete a generation and its output from the Dare library. Destructive and irreversible — confirm with the user first. Does not refund credits.

tools.name: dare_upload_media
tools.description: Upload an image, video or audio file to Dare and return its storage key, for use as a reference in dare_generate_video or dare_generate_image. Accepts a local file path, a public URL, or base64 bytes. Spends no credits.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file this server can read.

url.description: Public URL to download and upload.

name.description: Display name in the Dare library.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. `image/png`. Inferred when omitted.

tools.name: dare_list_uploads
tools.description: List previously uploaded reference media with their storage keys. Read-only, cursor-paginated.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

tools.name: dare_delete_upload
tools.description: Permanently delete an uploaded reference asset from the Dare library. Destructive and irreversible — confirm with the user first. Generations that already used it are unaffected.

upload_id.description: Upload id from dare_upload_media or dare_list_uploads.

tools.name: dare_list_projects
tools.description: List the account's Dare projects, for filing generations under a project id. Read-only.

response_format.description: `markdown` for a readable summary, `json` for the raw payload.

instructions: Generate video and images on Dare (trydare.com), billed to the signed-in user's Dare credit balance. Seedance 2.5 is the default video model. Generation is asynchronous and SPENDS CREDITS: call dare_estimate_cost first when cost matters, and confirm with the user before large batches. To use reference images or clips, upload them with dare_upload_media and pass the returned storage_key. Poll dare_get_generation for results, or set wait_seconds on the create tools.
